name: react-sol-advisor
description: Generic Sol Development Advisor for Codex with detached and evidence-gated native Luna, Terra, and Sol review adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Apply one generic production-delivery core across Codex and Cursor bindings with evidence-gated Luna, Terra, Sol, Composer, and Grok lanes.
interface.longDescription: Sol Development Advisor is a generic production delivery advisor. Sol stays in the primary session for architecture, decomposition, verification, and acceptance. Every implementation stream carries production-delivery, with React, TypeScript backend, Postgres/data, and worker/integration profiles selected from owned paths and acceptance. Codex preserves the validated detached Luna / Max / Fast lifecycle, adds an optional native Luna / Max role only when runtime and service-tier evidence is trustworthy, and retains Terra / High plus fresh Sol review. Cursor provides Composer, Luna, and Grok editor agents with exact user-configured model IDs and separate requested-versus-observed evidence. React Sol Advisor remains a legacy alias, not a React-only mode. Optional Linear intake is read-only and never a hard dependency.
defaultPrompt: Emit ADVISOR ROUTE before any client-specific call; select profiles from owned code and acceptance, never from the invocation phrase.
For bounded economy work use detached Luna / Max / Fast only when the tier is set and observed; native Luna requires the same evidence, otherwise follow the declared policy without silent fallback.
For critical implementation work, keep architecture in Sol, route implementation through Terra / High, then require a fresh Sol review.
